brief:
The Guardian reported that a political showdown is brewing within the Democratic party over its stance toward Israel, with support for the country becoming an increasingly costly electoral issue. Donald Trump has publicly acknowledged that backing Israel now carries political risk in American politics, signaling a broader shift in voter sentiment that party leadership cannot ignore.

Abdul El-Sayed's successful campaign to the U.S. Senate demonstrates that candidates openly questioning unconditional Israel support can win major races. The Guardian's analysis suggests Democratic officials must now reckon with this result as they chart the party's Middle East policy going forward.
dek: Even Donald Trump has acknowledged that support for Israel is increasingly a political liability in US politics. Will the Democratic leadership listen? Abdul El-Sayed’s victorious path to the US Senate must become a wake-up call to the Democratic party .
title: Democratic divide widens over Israel support policy
